exposure: double-layer unlocked uterine incision closure group
double-layer locked uterine incision closure group
single-layer unlocked uterine incision closure group
single-layer locked uterine incision closure group
outcome: thickness of the residual myometrial tissue
cohort: 60 women who underwent their first, elective, term cesarean section delivery at the Obstetrics and Gynecology clinic of a tertiary care center between November 2018 and November 2019
finding: There was no significant difference in CS defect measurements or area between the four uterine incision closure groups, but the sample size was not large enough to draw valid conclusions.
mod_finding: The lowest rate of Grade 3 isthmocele was seen in the double-locked group (5%), while the highest rate of isthmocele was seen in the single-unlocked group (35%).
